_instrucoes: File curated BY HAND, versioned. Add an item to 'alertas' when ADAPAR/IDR-PR publish a bulletin or alert. Fields: id, praga, cultura_afetada, nivel (baixo|moderado|alto), regiao (list: 'Oeste do PR', 'PR' or municipality names), data (YYYY-MM-DD of the bulletin), validade_dias (default 30), fonte (agency), url (bulletin), resumo (sentence from the bulletin, without making up numbers). Expired alerts (data + validade_dias) are ignored. Do not record losses or probabilities.
